title: Datasources: POST /api/v1/datasources accepts and silently drops a top-level password or connectionString that os compile refuses, answering 201
body:
domain:devx#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcUWM7N73xRVd64cyAE

QA-source: #28545 · integration-system.datasource-credential-refusal-matrix · observed beside the clauses

The runtime datasource admin door and the build door disagree on a credential written at the top level of a datasource body. `os compile` refuses it by name with the "must never be inlined" prescription. `POST /api/v1/datasources` answers 201 and drops the key without a word, so the author gets a datasource that cannot connect and no explanation. No credential is stored or served, so nothing leaks. Found by an off-clause probe and reproduced twice.

## Reproduction (stock showcase at `eeec88d1`, as admin, with a PostgreSQL that requires a password)
1. `POST /api/v1/datasources` with `{"name":"r7p_top","driver":"postgres","config":{"url":"postgres://app@127.0.0.1:PGPORT/db"},"password":"PLAINTEXT"}` → **201**. The datasource then fails to connect (`SASL … client password must be a string`).
2. `GET /api/v1/datasources/r7p_top`: the stored record has no `password` anywhere, and no read door shows it.
3. The same datasource authored in `objectstack.config.ts` and run through `os compile` exits 2 with "Unrecognized key(s) on this datasource: `password` … must never be inlined …".
4. Second repro (`r7p_top2`): a top-level `connectionString` carrying URL userinfo is dropped the same way, again with 201.

**Expected:** a 400 naming the key, with the same prescription the build door gives (bind the credential through `external.credentialsRef`), as the door already does for `config.password`.
**Actual:** 201, the key silently projected away.

## Mechanism
`packages/services/service-datasource/src/datasource-admin-service.ts`, `createDatasource`, around lines 686–692. `this.toRecord(input)` projects only the known fields into the record, and only then does `assertValidRecord` run, so an unknown top-level key never reaches validation. The same class of door disagreement was closed for cross-field refinements in #21058.
